Overview

This page is the in-browser test fixture for scripts/amvcp-report-doc.js. It loads amvcp-designmd.js and amvcp-report-doc.js as browser globals and (because window.__vcReportDocManualInit is set) lets the inline boot script apply the engine tokens, inject the report-doc CSS, and call init(document) deterministically — so the test owns the order of CSS-inject and runtime wiring.

The page exercises every component the skill ships: the doc shell, the whitepaper template (note the 01, 02 leading-zero numbering on each h2), the five callout variants, a scored rubric, a pull-quote, the metrics row, the TOC with scroll-spy, and the print stylesheet (defined in CSS only — only visible in print preview). Each is themed entirely off --vc-* tokens, so a theme toggle recolors the page without re-rendering.

// the public API exposed to tests:
//   injectReportDocCSS(doc)
//   init(root)
//   refresh(root)
//   runGates(documentOrRoot, pageId)   -> QaReport
//   runGatesOnHtml(htmlText, pageId)   -> QaReport
//   contrastRatio(a, b)                -> number
//   resetLoopState()

Callouts

Each callout variant maps to one --vc-color-* role (success / warning / info / accent / danger). The accent border and the tinted background re-derive automatically when the engine swaps the role value, so light + dark are correct without a per- theme rule.

Tip

Re-author rather than copy when you re-target a renderer.

Warning

Inner scrollbars defeat find-in-page and screen readers.

Info

Banned hue range covers purple/violet/indigo (255–320 deg).

Note

The pure-black / pure-white ban applies to design-role values only — print-block overrides are exempt by design.

Danger

Failing the same gate twice in a row should escalate, not auto- retry. The runner is advisory; it never auto-fixes.

Rubric

A scored matrix used to evaluate alternatives. The total row picks up the accent-tint background (color-mix(in srgb, accent 10%, transparent)) so it works in both themes without a per-theme rule.

Engine choice — three options, four criteria, weight 1–5.
CriterionOption AOption BOption C
Themeability 5 3 4
Verifiability 4 2 5
Print fidelity 5 5 3
Dependency footprint 5 3 4
Total 19 13 16
